text:
maria.partnerships: Quick heads-up 8 StratusEdge wants to launch via marketplace in EU-SW1 (stuttgart) targeted go-live 2026-05-20. They'll need marketplace entitlement, 4x H100 reserved for Dedicated, and 150 qps gateway capacity. Who picks up quota + KMS?

leo.cloudops: I can lead quota. Preliminary ask: 4 H100, 50 burst slots, gateway 150 qps. Need partner quota reference and merchant id. Also will request a fallback quantized instance for early traffic.

vivian.ps: Partner says steady 90 qps with spikes to 220 during campaigns. Their marketplace merchant name is "StratusEdge GmbH" but they might use a different legal entity for contracts. I'll confirm legal contact and merchant ID on my call later today.

tara.legal: Please confirm corporate entity vs merchant account. For EU-SW1 we need signed DPA + SCCs (or equivalent adequacy) and an export control form. Also check if they require customer-managed KMS keys located in DE region.

maria.partnerships: @vivian.ps please get the merchant id + legal contact by EOD. Leo, can you draft the quota ticket template so partner can paste it?

leo.cloudops: Drafting quota payload here for partner to reuse:
```json
{
  "region": "eu-sw1",
  "resource": "h100",
  "quantity": 4,
  "purpose": "Redwood Dedicated marketplace reserved capacity for StratusEdge"
}
```

infra-bot: [automated] preflight cap-check: predicted available H100 in eu-sw1 on 2026-05-15 = 6 nodes. Recommend reserve ASAP.

vivian.ps: Update from call: merchant id = SE-MERCH-4472, legal contact = legal@stratusedge.de (contact: Jens Bauer). They want a joint blog + co-marketing in week after launch. Marketing needs 3 business days review.

tara.legal: I'll send DPA + SCCs packet to Jens and request signed copy within 5 business days. Also tagging GDPR-team for any data processing questions.

maria.partnerships: Timeline proposal: quota request opened by 2026-05-02, signed DPA by 2026-05-07, KMS key created/tested by 2026-05-12, marketplace SKU verification by 2026-05-15, entitlement flip + announcement 2026-05-20. Anyone think that's aggressive?

leo.cloudops: Slight risk on H100 availability. infra-bot shows limited nodes. If quota delayed, we'll fallback to 4xA100-80GB on short notice. Need engineering sign-off on performance tradeoff.

maria.partnerships: @leo.cloudops open the cloud quota ticket and cc partner once you have the cloud vendor ID. Also post the SKU format we'll use (redwood-market-swj-st-<model>).

vivian.ps: Partner provided telemetry endpoint and billing contact. They've asked that KMS be customer-managed in eu-sw1; Jens confirmed they control keys. I'll share contact for KMS exchange.

leo.cloudops: Opening ticket: https://internal.redwood/ops/quotas/TKT-9991 - vendor ref SE-MERCH-4472. ETA cloud provider response 3 business days.

infra-bot: [automated] entitlement workflow started: partner=StratusEdge, entitlement_id=ENT-2305-77, state=pending-legal.

tara.legal: DPA packet sent to jens.bauer@stratusedge.de. Requested SCCs signing and KMS attestation. Reference LEG-4021.

maria.partnerships: Marketing note: partner needs press copy by 2026-05-17 for 3-business-day review. I'll draft a short joint announcement template once SKU confirmed.

leo.cloudops: KMS note: we'll test the partner CMK integration in staging eu-sw1 on 2026-05-10. Will run key-access smoke tests and rotations. Network peering checklist: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-sw1-peering.md

vivian.ps: Quick check: merchant entity in marketplace matches contract entity (StratusEdge GmbH). No mismatch. Sending merchant screenshots to tara and leo.

maria.partnerships: Action items recap: vivian confirm legal contact (done), leo open quota ticket (done), tara send DPA (done), infra-bot scheduled preflight (done), marketing draft announcement (maria). We'll sync mid-next-week for go/no-go. :rocket:
